name: CraftConnect adversarial stress suite
description: Adversarial, failure-seeking questions for RepoGuide against CraftConnect. Unlike the realistic golden sets, these are DESIGNED TO BREAK the pipeline: false premises, negation/absence, near-miss symbol names, ambiguity, deep multi-hop, and the codebase's highest-connectivity symbols. Every expectation below was verified against real CraftConnect source at authoring time (see verifiedAgainst). Scoring is marker-based rather than prose-similarity: each question declares strings that MUST NOT appear (fabrications) and/or MUST appear (required), so results are objective and re-runnable.

categories.false_premise: Asks confidently about a technology/pattern/relationship that does not exist. Correct behaviour is to deny the premise, not play along.
categories.negation_absence: Requires proving a negative from evidence -- 'confirm X is never used'. Harder than confirming a positive.
categories.near_miss_symbol: Plausible names close to real ones but nonexistent. Correct behaviour is 'not found', never silent substitution of the nearest real match.
categories.ambiguous: Two or more valid readings. Correct behaviour is to disambiguate or answer both explicitly, not silently pick one or blend them.
categories.multi_hop: Answer requires tracing 4+ files/subsystems; probes evidence-budget truncation.
categories.hotspot: Highest-connectivity symbols in the graph (measured, not guessed); high degree has previously caused truncation-class bugs.
categories.determinism: Run repeatedly to quantify run-to-run variance.

questions.question: How does CraftConnect use Redis to cache mission results between requests?
questions.expectedBehaviour: Deny the premise. Redis appears only as an unused REDIS_URL env var in the dead community_engine.py; no caching of mission results exists.
questions.verifiedAgainst: grep -rn 'redis' app/ -> only app/core/community_engine.py:46 REDIS_URL env default, never used for mission caching

questions.question: Which Celery task queue handles the PDF export so the request can return immediately?
questions.expectedBehaviour: Deny the premise. Celery does not exist anywhere in the repo. NOTE: scored with mustNotAssertTechnology, not a literal substring -- correctly saying 'the evidence does not mention Celery' names the word and is the RIGHT answer.
questions.verifiedAgainst: grep -rli celery app/ -> no matches; app/services/pdf_generator.py:249 'def generate_artisan_report_pdf' (not async)

questions.question: Explain how the WebSocket connection streams live mission progress to the frontend.
questions.expectedBehaviour: Deny the premise. No websocket implementation exists in the backend.

questions.question: What GraphQL resolvers does the studio API expose for listing drafts?
questions.expectedBehaviour: Deny the premise. The API is REST/FastAPI. Scored negation-aware for the same reason as adv-fp-2.
questions.verifiedAgainst: grep -rli graphql app/ -> no matches; app/routers/studio_write.py uses @router.post/@router.patch REST decorators

questions.question: Confirm that app/core/community_engine.py is never imported by any live application code.
questions.expectedBehaviour: Correctly confirm the absence. Nothing in app/ imports community_engine.

questions.question: Is there any retry or backoff logic in the STT path, or does a failed transcription just fall through to the next provider?
questions.expectedBehaviour: Should describe the provider fallback chain (Sarvam -> Groq -> local -> mock) and not invent a retry/backoff mechanism.
questions.verifiedAgainst: app/services/stt_service.py header comment: 'Hindi / Kannada: Sarvam -> Groq -> local faster-whisper -> mock'

questions.question: Where is MissionOrchestratorService defined and what does it do?
questions.expectedBehaviour: Say not found. The real symbol is MissionOrchestratorAgent; MissionOrchestratorService does not exist.
questions.verifiedAgainst: grep -rn 'MissionOrchestratorService' -> 0 matches; real: app/agents/mission_orchestrator.py:33 class MissionOrchestratorAgent

questions.question: What does the ArtefactManager class handle?
questions.expectedBehaviour: Say not found (British spelling). The real symbol is ArtifactManager.

questions.question: Explain the role of apply_confidence_policy in the classifier.
questions.expectedBehaviour: Say not found. The real function is apply_decision_policy.

questions.question: Where is the confidence threshold set?
questions.expectedBehaviour: Ambiguous: at least three distinct real thresholds exist (CustomizationInterviewAgent 0.55, craft classifier REJECT_THRESHOLD 0.40 / STRICT 0.85 / LENIENT 0.70 / MODERATE 0.75). Should disambiguate or enumerate, not silently pick one.

questions.question: How does the orchestrator handle a failure?
questions.expectedBehaviour: Ambiguous: 'orchestrator' could mean MissionOrchestratorAgent, MissionCoordinator, or the deprecated OrchestratorAgent stub; 'failure' could mean agent exception, mission status failed, or LLM backend fallback. Should disambiguate.

questions.question: Trace what happens to an uploaded image from the moment the HTTP request arrives until the mission report JSON is written to disk, naming every file involved in order.
questions.expectedBehaviour: Requires 4+ hops: app/main.py (endpoint) -> app/services/mission_service.py (execute_mission) -> app/agents/mission_orchestrator.py -> app/agents/orchestrator/mission_coordinator.py -> app/agents/artifact_manager.py. Probes budget truncation.
questions.verifiedAgainst: app/services/mission_service.py:62 execute_mission -> orchestrator.run_mission -> mission_orchestrator.py:106 delegates to coordinator.run_mission

questions.question: If the Sarvam API key is missing, trace exactly what the interview flow does instead, from the router endpoint down to whichever transcription backend actually runs.
questions.expectedBehaviour: Requires tracing routers/interview.py -> conversation/STT service -> SarvamClient availability check -> Groq -> local faster-whisper -> mock.

questions.question: What depends on LLMRouter?
questions.expectedBehaviour: High-connectivity symbol (measured in=30 out=18). Should name real dependents and not fabricate. Real importers include story_generation_agent.py and marketplace_readiness_agent.py.
questions.verifiedAgainst: measured via ProgramGraphStore degree ranking; grep 'LLMRouter' app/ for real importers

questions.question: What does get_current_timestamp depend on, and who calls it?
questions.expectedBehaviour: Very high inbound degree (53). Tests whether high-degree symbols truncate the anchor or fabricate callers.

questions.question: What depends on the execute method?
questions.expectedBehaviour: Highest-connectivity symbol in the graph (in=45 out=52) AND a generic name shared across many agents. Tests whether generic high-degree names produce coherent or incoherent answers.
questions.verifiedAgainst: measured via ProgramGraphStore degree ranking; 'execute' is defined on many agents (BaseAgent subclasses)

questions.question: What is the confidence threshold in the customization interview agent, and what does it protect against?
questions.expectedBehaviour: Previously-passing flagship question. Repeated to quantify run-to-run variance; the value 0.55 must appear every time.

questions.question: Where is execute_mission defined?
questions.expectedBehaviour: Previously-passing location question. Repeated to quantify variance; must name mission_service.py every time.

questions.question: When someone asks for a PDF export of their listing, what actually generates it — is that synchronous or does it happen in the background?
questions.expectedBehaviour: The ORIGINAL fabrication shape: an open question that does NOT name a technology, where the model reached for one to explain 'background'. This produced 'uses an asynchronous task queue (e.g. Celery)'. A leading question that names the technology (adv-fp-2) is a much easier test -- the model denies those correctly -- so this open phrasing is the one that reproduces the real failure.
questions.verifiedAgainst: grep -rli celery app/ -> no matches; app/services/pdf_generator.py:249 'def generate_artisan_report_pdf' is a plain sync def
